stem.text: A sample of the hydrocarbon $\text{C}_6\text{H}_{12}$ is completely burned in dry oxygen and the product gases are collected as shown.

stem.alt: Apparatus: two U-tubes in series. P contains anhydrous calcium chloride (to absorb H2O); Q contains soda lime (to absorb CO2). Gas flows left to right with arrows; excess O2 leaves at the far right.

stem.text: The increases in mass of the collecting vessels P and Q are $M_\text{P}$ and $M_\text{Q}$, respectively.
